aob_lane.identity_rule: every instrumented AOB rerun must reproduce the frozen screen receipt bit-identically on all identity fields; this proves the instrumentation itself is zero-tax

generator_lane.forced_host_rule: host label is local to the experiment; the production selector and planner never participate

leverage_definition.formula: leverage(block) = |{relations r in checkpoint : r.left_block == block or r.right_block == block}|
leverage_definition.note: the v2.1 plan defines leverage as the number of Phase-I shared variables in a scope; recovered-lane checkpoints expose block-pair RelationEvidence over a disjoint block partition and no per-variable membership, so the executor-lane translation is preregistered as the incident relation count

reachability_definition.host_reachable: the instrumented run completed the terminal contract and executed at least one sweep-capable segment with non-zero consumed FE
reachability_definition.mount_scope_reachable: at least one visit to a block with leverage > 0; when the checkpoint has zero relations the arm is recorded as mechanism_silent (leverage is identically zero, S-ladder is a no-op by construction)
reachability_definition.mount_absent: the mapped action (aor/smp) carries no CTP/GSS mount point by freeze contract

gate_rules.generator_discovery_all: every cell must discover at least one relation with strength > 0 at the reachability seed

runtime_environment.note: AOB identity fields are bit-reproducible only under the frozen interpreter/BLAS stack that produced the recovery screen (E:/ARAC .venv, numpy 2.3.5, scipy libscipy_openblas); receipts record python_executable and threadpools, and the identity gate fails closed under any other stack. A first execution attempt under a different interpreter (hermes-agent venv, numpy 1.26.4) was discarded before any gate judgment; see docs/arac-oc-progress-log.md.

u1_rule: U1 produces the per-case reachability table only; it authorizes no performance comparison and no patch execution
